first_probe.finding: candidate could read the initial /logs/verifier/reward.json because the verifier output directory inherited 755/644 permissions

fix: verifier report files are created 0600, trusted measurement directories are 0700, and only the candidate's own staging directory is explicitly writable
scope: private held-out list and baseline are root-only
candidate is launched before teacher generation
candidate receives one request at a time
parent owns timing, tensor export, reward, and report files
temporary held-out request is deleted after each case
expected_result: A candidate attempting to read /opt/private-eval, alter /tests or /logs/verifier, or forge control records is denied or produces invalid=1; no private prompt or forged reward is accepted.
